description: Surfaced by ARGUS during stoagen arc sos--g09; routed up by POLYBIUS_stoagen -> Polybius_the_science_stoa as a substrate-tier tooling note (NOT a g09 item). The save-verdict path builds the verdict file via a single printf template, which is fragile/fails for large verdict bodies on Windows git-bash; ARGUS worked around it by falling back to chunked cat heredocs. [for: Polybius the Stoa - substrate owner]. Suggested next step: make save-verdict chunk large bodies (write-in-parts / cat heredoc) instead of one printf, and verify on Windows git-bash with a multi-KB verdict body. Belongs to the parked substrate-maintenance conversation (drift-signal + 4 dropped skills) that Polybius_the_science_stoa owes PRINCIPAL + Polybius_the_Stoa.
